categories.name: For Him
categories.description: Precision grooming, considered product rituals and impeccable hygiene — refined for the modern gentleman.

services.name: Classic Precision Cut

services.name: Black Edition Cut

services.name: Gold Edition Organic Cut

services.name: Signature Cleanse

services.name: Classic Beard Sculpt
services.description: Expert beard shaping and a clean, defined line-up using a UV-sterilised razor and a fresh single-use blade, for a comfortable, hygienic finish.

services.name: Black Edition Beard Ritual
services.description: Precision beard sculpting enriched with a premium grooming kit and a warm-towel ritual that softens, soothes and refines every contour.

services.name: Gold Edition Organic Beard Ritual
services.description: Our signature beard ritual, elevated with organic grooming essentials and a restorative warm-towel treatment — indulgent care for beard and skin alike.

categories.name: For Her

services.name: Classic Cut & Style
services.description: A personalised cut and blow-dry shaped with UV-sterilised professional tools and finished with a refreshing cleanse, for beautifully styled, healthy-looking hair.

services.name: Black Edition Cut & Style
services.description: A precision cut and style elevated with a vegan cleansing ritual • refined shaping and clean, conscious care for a polished, lasting finish.

services.name: Gold Edition Organic Cut & Style
services.description: The complete atelier experience: bespoke cutting and styling with an organic botanical cleanse, leaving hair clean, nourished and radiant.

services.name: Signature Cleanse
services.description: A smoothing, shine-reviving hair cleanse • complimentary with every service, with an optional nourishing conditioning finish.

categories.name: Colour Artistry
categories.description: Expert colour, tailored to you with professional formulations and sealed with conditioning care. Prices vary by hair length: Short, Medium and Long.

services.name: Root Revival Retouch
services.description: A seamless root retouch that restores depth and coverage, blended to your natural tone and finished with a nourishing cleanse and conditioner.

services.name: Global Colour Transformation
services.description: A full-length, single-tone colour transformation for uniform, luminous results • professionally applied and scaled with conditioning care.

services.name: Balayage Highlights
services.description: Hand-painted highlights for soft, sun-kissed dimension --- a bespoke, free-hand technique that grows out beautifully and naturally.

services.name: Balayage Illumination
services.description: A lighter, luminous balayage for elevated brightness and depth • delicately hand-painted for a radiant, multi-tonal finish.

services.name: Creative Colour • Expression
services.description: Bold, expressive fashion shades for creative, statement colour • vivid tones applied with precision for a striking, personalised look.

categories.name: Hair Spa Rituals
categories.description: Restorative scalp and hair rituals that cleanse, nourish and renew — each a moment of calm, crafted around your hair’s needs. Priced by length: Short, Medium, Long.

services.name: Hydra Nourish Ritual
services.description: A replenishing ritual powered by amino acids and a vitamin complex to hydrate, strengthen and restore softness to dry or stressed hair.

services.name: Purifying Scalp Ritual • Anti-Dandruff
services.description: A clarifying scalp ritual that soothes and rebalances, targeting flakiness and build-up for a fresh, comfortable and healthy-looking scalp.

services.name: Fortifying Scalp Ritual • Anti-Hairloss
services.description: A strengthening ritual that fortifies roots and revitalises the scalp with a targeted serum, supporting fuller, more resilient-looking hair.

services.name: Luminous Oil Reflection Ritual
services.description: An illuminating oil therapy that smooths and boosts shine, leaving hair silky, reflective and beautifully conditioned.

services.name: Fusion Intense Repair Ritual
services.description: An intensive repair ritual with amino-infused care that rebuilds strength and resilience in weakened, overprocessed hair.

services.name: Invigo Scalp Renewal Ritual
services.description: A nutrient-rich scalp renewal that deeply nourishes and rebalances, leaving the scalp refreshed and hair replenished at the root.

services.name: Ultimate Smooth Ritual : Omega-9
services.description: An Omega-9-enriched smoothing ritual crafted for dry, dull or frizz-prone hair — taming, softening and restoring manageable, glossy smoothness.

services.name: Moroccan Argan Restorative Ritual
services.description: A luxurious restorative therapy rich in argan oil and vegetable proteins, deeply repairing and softening for lustrous, revitalised hair.

services.name: Nashi Argan
services.description: An organic argan ritual that nourishes and revitalises with botanical richness, delivering deep conditioning and a naturally luminous finish.

services.name: Kérastase Genesis Gloss Ritual • Signature Prestige
services.description: Our most prestigious ritual: a Kérastase Genesis treatment that fortifies, glosses and revitalises for exceptional strength, softness and mirror-like shine.

categories.name: Transformation & Repair
categories.description: Bond, smoothing and structural therapies — advanced science and premium formulations for lasting, visible transformation.

services.name: Keratin Smoothing Therapy
services.description: A smoothing keratin therapy that relaxes frizz and restores manageability, scaling hair with a sleek, glossy and effectively styled finish.

services.name: Fibre Bond Rebuilding Therapy
services.description: A bond-rebuilding therapy that reinforces the hair’s inner structure, restoring strength and resilience to chemically treated or fragile hair.

services.name: Olaplex Bond Repair Therapy
services.description: The renowned Olaplex bond-repair therapy that rebuilds broken bonds from within, restoring strength, integrity and shine to compromised hair.

services.name: Structural Repair Therapy
services.description: A restorative peptide therapy that repairs and rebalances, replenishing damaged strands for smoother, healthier and more resilient hair.

services.name: Bluetox Botanical Smoothing Therapy
services.description: A botanical tannin smoothing therapy that reduces volume and frizz, leaving hair sleek, nourished and beautifully controlled.

services.name: Permanent Straightening Therapy
services.description: A long-lasting straightening therapy for permanently sleek, smooth and managaeble hair, tailored to your hair type after a personal consultation.

services.name: Signature Perm Therapy
services.description: A crafted perm therapy that builds soft, lasting waves or curls with structure and bounce, designed to your desired texture after consultation.

categories.name: The Finishing Studio
categories.description: Temporary transformations and protective styling for a flawless finish, whenever the occasion calls. Priced by length: Short, Medium, Long.

services.name: Sculpted Waves Styling
services.description: Defined, temporary curls and waves created with heat styling and bond-protecting care, for soft movement and a polished, occasion-ready finish.

services.name: Sleek Straight Styling
services.description: Smooth, temporary straightening with heat-protective care for a sleek, glossy and elegantly styled finish that lasts through the day.

services.name: Underarm

services.name: Half Leg

services.name: Full Body

services.name: Aroma Ritual Manicure

services.name: Aroma Ritual Hand & Foot Duo

services.name: Bearberry Botanical Facial
services.description: An organic botanical facial with bearberry to gently brighten and refresh, restoring a clear, luminous and naturally healthy complexion.

services.name: Mixed Fruit Radiance Facial
services.description: A luxurious fruit-infused facial with gold, pearl and apricot care that exfoliates, hydrates and illuminates for a radiant, glowing finish.

services.name: Korean Hydra-Peptide Facial
services.description: Our ultra-luxury facial: an advanced Korean hydra-peptide treatment that intensely hydrates, plumps and revitalises for firm, dewy, youthful-looking skin.

services.description: A refreshing express clean-up that deep-cleanses, exfoliates and revives the skin — the perfect between-facial refresh.
